description: Search for a pay-per-call (x402) API that does what you need. Unlike a raw directory, results are limited to endpoints that answered a real x402 payment challenge AND had at least 5 settled calls from at least 2 distinct payers in the last 30 days, so dead, never-bought and template-farm listings are left out. Each result has the endpoint URL, method, price in USD, networks, 30-day calls and unique payers, and a flag when the payer count looks farmed. Use it when you need a paid API (search, scraping, enrichment, LLM, market data…) and want one that demonstrably works. Wraps GET /v1/x402/search. Same free daily tier as read_url; $0.005/call via x402 after that.

max_price_usd.description: Only return endpoints priced at or below this, per call.

network.description: Payment network: base, solana, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, or a CAIP-2 id.

query.description: What the API should do, in a few words, e.g. 'web search' or 'email verification'.

name: search_x402_services
title: Find live, paid-for x402 APIs for a task
